import random
r = random.Random(7)
out = []
for _ in range(60):
    n = r.randint(0, 12)
    m = [(r.choice([0, 1, 2, 3, 5]), r.randint(-9, 12), r.random() < 0.15) for _ in range(n)]
    out.append(sol.best_context(m, r.randint(0, 18), r.randint(0, 4), r.choice([0, 2, 5, -3])))
result = out
